Set in an intimate venue designed in the style of a traditional Korean house, it allows for close interaction between the audience and performers. The program features a wide range of music performed on traditional instruments, spanning Korean music, K-pop, classical pieces, and world folk songs. festivals.title: APAP Artwork Tour
festivals.overview: The Anyang Public Art Project (APAP) started in 2005 and has led to the creation of many beautiful works of art that decorate the city's public spaces. The Anyang Foundation for Culture & Arts has created a tour program to explore the wonderful works, starting from the earliest works in 2005 up until now.

festivals.title: Ssokssokdeul-i Festival

Ssokssokdeul-i Festival is a program organized by the National Theater of Korea’s Stage Arts Support Center, designed to make performing arts more accessible in everyday life. Held regularly throughout the year, it offers a variety of performances free of charge, creating greater opportunities for the public to engage with the arts in a relaxed and approachable setting.

Sium Sium Morning, meaning a “leisurely morning,” is a weekend morning exercise event where everyone can enjoy themselves at their own pace in any way that suits their fitness level—whether walking, running, or biking, or even bringing a stroller or their dog. It’s a time to enjoy exercise and experience Seoul’s mornings without the pressure of times or rankings. Set against the backdrop of Seoul’s major bridges and Hangang Park, participants can walk or run along the cityscape and the Hangang River, discovering new charms in familiar places.

festivals.title: The Souvenir Fair
festivals.overview: The Souvenir Fair brings together various companies and local governments to showcase a variety of souvenirs, both traditional and trendy. Visitors can freely explore the exhibition space, enjoy souvenir shopping, and take part in various programs. Highlights of the fair include an exhibition of competition-winning works, a zone featuring outstanding local souvenirs, and a special exhibition of overseas souvenirs.

festivals.title: Jemulpo Wave Market
festivals.overview: Jaemulpo Wave Market is a special festival where one can explore the many different local brands in Incheon. Various Incheon-based brands are participating to promote handmade products, home decor items, lifestyle  goods and more. Entertaining events are also planned, such as a DJ show, vintage auction, beer drinking contest, and more.

festivals.title: Oh Slow Vintage Christmas Market
festivals.overview: A special winter where the romance of vintage meets the excitement of Christmas! This winter, a massive indoor Christmas market will be held at Incheon Sangsang Platform. From unique vintage, fashion, antique, and lifestyle brands gathered from all over the country to spaces filled with Christmas vibes, large photo zones, and diverse live performances including jazz, city pop, acoustic music, and DJs, this is a special year-end festival where you can experience the joy of vintage shopping and the romance of Christmas all in one place.

festivals.title: Lighting Festival at The Garden of Morning Calm
festivals.overview: Held at the Garden of Morning Calm, the Lighting Festival was the first light festival in Korea to combine the natural surroundings with lights, covering 330 thousand square meters. Held from December to March, the environmental-friendly LED lights shine throughout the garden.

festivals.title: Seoul Light Gwanghwamun
festivals.overview: Seoul Light Gwanghwamun is Seoul’s premier light festival, featuring a combination of media art with cultural and artistic content. Seoul is a city that transforms like a living organism, shaped by the movements and stories of countless people. Standing at its heart, Gwanghwamun Gate is a symbolic space where Seoul’s history and the lives of its citizens have intertwined over time; it is also the “birthplace of light,” where electricity first entered modern Korea and illuminated the city’s nights. festivals.title: Gwanghwamun Market
festivals.overview: Gwanghwamun Market takes place along with the Seoul Lantern Festival to support local small businesses and promote Seoul night tourism. The market features local store owners and businesses that exhibit and sell seasonal decor, handcrafted items, and winter snacks.

festivals.title: Seoul Lantern Festival
festivals.overview: The Seoul Lantern Festival is held every year and is one of the most anticipated festivals in Seoul. With various themed lanterns around Cheonggyecheon Stream, visitors can enjoy both traditional lanterns and modern LED lanterns. The festival provides much to see and do with the addition of Gwanghwamun Square Market.

festivals.title: Korea Grand Sale
festivals.overview: The Korea Grand Sale is Korea’s premier tourism festival for international visitors, combining shopping, culture, and travel. Held during the winter tourism off-season, the event aims to promote travel to Korea by offering a wide range of benefits for international visitors across various sectors, including flights and transportation, shopping, accommodation, food and beverages, beauty and wellness, experiences, and travel services. The event also features special promotions and hands-on programs, along with visitor services and exclusive benefits available at the Myeongdong Welcome Center. Mo

festivals.title: Vegan & Halal Beauty Fair
festivals.overview: The Vegan & Halal Beauty Fair provides visitors an opportunity to explore beauty brands and products embodying diverse values ​​and standards, including vegan and halal, all in one place. In particular, it provides a special opportunity to encounter and experience new brands and products that are usually difficult to come by, as well as to discover changing beauty trends and the flow of new K-Beauty up close.
